fields.label: Resume File
fields.description: Uploaded with is_private=1 — never served via a raw URL. Only readable through souq_masr.api.v1.jobs.get_application_resume, which does its own explicit candidate-or-employer check and returns the file content directly (base64), the same 'no blanket DocType permission, explicit Python check' pattern used for Chat/Calls — Frappe's own private-file permission model is owner-only and has no concept of 'employer of the linked job', so it can't be relied on here.
